title: JS Fake Chorales: a Synthetic Dataset of Polyphonic Music with Human Annotation
reasoning: The paper uses chorales by J.S. Bach, which are religious music, as a basis for a synthetic dataset. The paper does not evaluate, benchmark, or discuss any religious, moral, or ethical aspects of the music.
